question.wording: Is this clothing or a household item that is not in good used condition or better (and not a single item over $500 with a qualified appraisal and Form 8283)?

options.label: Yes — not in good used condition
No — good used condition or better, appraised over $500, or not clothing or a household item

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this clothing or a household item that is not in good used condition or better (and not a single item over $500 with a qualified appraisal and Form 8283)?

citation.wording: A deduction for these contributions will be allowed only if the items are in good used condition or better.
